title: urn:qauth:ia:device_code:v1-rc.0
description: Code entry for the OAuth 2.0 device authorization grant (RFC 8628 §3.3). Unknown, expired and used codes give the same `invalid_user_code`. Entry is rate-limited per code, per session and per address. A person who arrives through `verification_uri_complete` skips this step and still confirms on `device_confirm` (ADR-020 §3). Works without JavaScript.

length.description: How many characters the code has, without the dash.

user_code.description: The code as typed. The server ignores case, spaces and dashes (RFC 8628 §6.1).

error.description: Why the last answer was refused. A closed set.

amr.description: The RFC 8176 `amr` values a successful answer adds to the transaction: none, because the step proves no authenticator.
